name: Y Ddraig Goch
title: Protector of Avalon
summary: Burn your enemies and Protect your Allies from Harmful Blaze and Burns.
lore: The terrible Red Dragon is the fiercest protector Avalon has—and a last resort nobody wants to invoke. When roused to the realm’s defense, Y Ddraig Goch devastates surrounding lands, armies, and communities, and though the bulk of it is inflicted on the enemy, swathes of Avalon also suffer. It seems to wreak such destruction deliberately, as though demanding a sacrifice for its aid.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Before attacking, increase the duration of any Blaze by 1 turn then activate Blaze.
Blocks any Debuff or Disable placed on this hero from enemies under Blaze or Aetherburn.
Transfers all Debuffs from all allies onto all enemies.
